title: FloorDesign
description: FloorDesign: Design of a floor bay, combining a floor configuration and its column configurations with the spans, loading and performance data (depth, mass, fire rating, edge condition and design code) the design was developed for.

FloorConfiguration.description: Configuration of the floor structure, i.e. the slab and framing, that the design is based on. IFloorConfiguration: Base interface for a floor structure configuration, describing the structural makeup of a floor bay such as RCFlatSlab or TimberInfillBeams. Specific configurations combine this with the interfaces describing the slab and framing they contain.

ColumnConfiguration.description: Column data for the columns supporting the floor, giving the column required for different numbers of supported stories. ColumnData: Collection of column configurations that together define the columns required to support a floor design. Each configuration gives the column required for a particular number of supported stories.

SpanX.description: Length of the primary beam or local X dimension. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

SpanY.description: Length of the secondary beam or local Y dimension. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

LoadSDL.description: Uniformly applied super-imposed dead load on the floor area. Property has a quantity of type Pressure measured in [Pa].

LoadLL.description: Uniformly applied live load on the floor area. Property has a quantity of type Pressure measured in [Pa].

Depth.description: Total floor depth from top of slab to bottom of deepest beam. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

Mass.description: Mass of the floor bay per area. Property has a quantity of type MassPerUnitArea measured in [kg/m²].

FireRating.description: Structural fire rating requirement. Property has a quantity of type Time measured in [s].

EdgeCondition.description: Position of the floor bay within the floor plate that the design applies to. Defaults to Interior. EdgeCondition: Position of a floor bay within the floor plate, which affects the design of the bay.

DesignCode.description: Structural engineering code to which the floor bay has been designed.

DesignNotes.description: Design assumptions and additional information about the design.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
